$comment: The story campaign's content (docs/CAMPAIGN.md; the design: docs/CAMPAIGN_GDD.md, the decisions: docs/STORY_CAMPAIGN.md). Sectors and convergence zones as data, by stable id (never rename an id: progress is saved by it). A sector: id, name, classification (historical, modern, future or unclassified), period, description, maps in play order (usually 3; a Wars sector one per war; each opens once the one before is won; map: a maps/<id>.json of the suite; unlock: the one character a win on it unlocks; optional, the map's own match: mode (a game mode id the map plays; absent: Team Deathmatch), picked (the crew the player picks, at most 14), allies (local allies added), enemies (enemy bots), waves (reinforcement waves, kept for later); the battle may be bigger than 14 a side, scaled to the device), boss (character: the boss's look; companions: the looks fighting beside it), rewards (looks unlocked when the sector is repaired: the boss or companions), expedition (crew: Chrono Crew members the player picks, usually 8-10, at most 14; allies: the sector's local allies, the looks a map's allies are drawn from). A convergence: id, name, description, sectors (its two prerequisite sectors: until both are repaired each shows only as an Unknown tile, no name), maps (in play order), rewards. provisional: true marks a placeholder the owner hasn't named or placed yet. Checked by packages/shared/test/campaign.test.ts (references resolve, sizes, ids unique).

sectors.name: The Jade Empire
sectors.description: Temple cities swallowed by the jungle, and a jaguar king who means to keep the sun for himself.

sectors.name: Lockdown
sectors.description: An airport, a ship and an island prison, all closed at once, and a customs agent who lets nobody through.

sectors.name: Neon Tomorrow
sectors.description: Glass towers, neon streets and an orbital station, policed by the time police's own inquisitor.

convergences.name: The Cold Cells
convergences.description: Today's prison and 2032's cryo vault meet across one fault line.
